defective_pattern: Using 'B Titr' font for non-chapter name headings, tables, or captions, and using manual line breaks (<w:br/>).
why_defective: Violates explicit user typography standards restricting B Titr exclusively to Chapter Names. Manual line breaks break justification.
observed_symptoms: B Titr applied to Table Headers or Captions
Manual line breaks (<w:br/>) present in document
corrective_remedy: Replace B Titr with B Nazanin for all elements except chapter names. Set body font to 14 pt, table fonts to 12 pt. Replace w:br with w:p.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Presence of B Titr in table cells, captions, or any non-Chapter 1/2/3/4/5 title.
